chain_words.nuance: able to do a task well enough
having the knowledge and ability required for a job
having learned abilities that are valued at work
highly able, with practice and confidence
showing outstanding, almost artistic control of a skill

explanation: These words all describe being good at doing something, from being able to do a task to showing exceptional mastery.

usage_notes.difference: 'Skilled' often describes abilities gained through training and used at work; 'proficient' stresses a high level of ability in a language or task.
